Definition: a primary verb (used as an alternate of G2068 in certain tenses); to eat (literally or figuratively):--eat, meat.
BiblicalUsage: Phago is the aorist of to eat, the word for the act itself, and it appears where the eating matters most. Jesus asks where He shall eat the passover with His disciples, He says He will not eat of it again until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God, and Paul says he will eat no flesh while the world stands, lest he make his brother stumble.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that eating in the Bible is never just eating: the passover meal, the kingdom's table, and a brother's conscience all hang on what goes into the mouth.
